points.description: States the core difference in output: classification maps data to discrete labels/categories, while regression maps data to continuous values (real numbers). Equivalent wording earns the mark.

States how error is measured in each task: classification error is the number of misclassifications; regression error is the summed distance between true and predicted values. Equivalent wording (e.g. count of wrong predictions; sum of differences between actual and predicted values) earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.5 for a correct classification error measure (number of misclassifications) and 0.5 for a correct regression error measure (summed distance between true and predicted values).
